three_retained_gaps.note: The enclosing span is not one uninterrupted no-progress gap; selected progress events split it.

todo_issue.assessment: A cached linked PR predates the gap. This does not by itself make the issue non-dispatchable, but proves that a todo label cannot establish a fresh runnable task or no existing work.

classifier_contract.assessment: Dispatchability is absence of selected recorded declines and attention, not a positive scheduler admission result. A later decline is projected backward across its label-state episode. If any modeled dispatchable todo/rework exists and an infrastructure window is open, d wins before human-waiting state is considered. Unresolved starvation is extended to the ID-group endpoint, whose boot meaning is unproved.

interpretation: The data supports a large model gap with concurrent waiting work. It does not distinguish 151 hours of active infrastructure failure from a stale alert, missing progress evidence or unobserved Executor availability. Nor does it establish that the whole interval should be moved to human-blocked b. The raw historical attendance fraction is0.004, displayed as0.00 at two decimals. That predicate does not prove zero observed activity or a six-day operator absence.
